errors.text_span: verzeichnet Anfang 2020 einen deutlichen Höhepunkt bei etwa 500
errors.evidence: The black line (Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt) peaks around 2020-2021 at approximately 500 on the left scale, which appears consistent. However, looking more carefully at the figure, the peak appears to be closer to around 450-490 for the black line, while the blue line reaches closer to 500. This is a minor issue but the description attributes the ~500 peak to the black line when it may be slightly lower.

errors.text_span: einem abschließenden, steilen Anstieg auf ungefähr 650 am rechten Diagrammrand
errors.evidence: The blue line (Finanzpolitik) appears to reach closer to 700 or slightly above at the rightmost end of the chart, not approximately 650.

The purple line (Handelspolitik) shows peaks around 2019-2020 that appear to reach approximately 1.500-2.000 on the right scale. The value of 2.000 is at the upper end of plausibility but could be considered a minor approximation issue.

The description does not mention that the purple line (Handelspolitik) also shows a small spike around 2019-2020 that is clearly visible before returning to near zero, and there appears to be a brief spike around 2024 before the large final spike. The description mentions 'mehrere Ausschläge' but doesn't note the intermediate spike around 2023-2024.
